symptom: Marketplace Calendar 2.6.1 page passes check and exec, then `mx check` fails `[CE0642] "Property 'Editable' is required."` and `"Property 'Show event date range' is required."`; `editable: 'true'` is accepted with no warning and changes nothing, `showEventDate:` warns MDL-WIDGET06 "will be dropped" although it is written, and `describe page` prints neither
cause: Four hops, each dropping the same value: (1) GenerateFromMPK's createDefaultWidgetValue had no Expression case, so `defaultValue="true"` was written as an empty expression; (2) GenerateDefJSON emitted no mapping for a top-level `expression` property, leaving it in KnownProperties (MDL-WIDGET06) and written only by the explicit pass; (3) that pass skips builtin names, and `editable` is also the widget-level editability, which the Calendar's package does not declare — so the widget's own `editable` was unreachable in every spelling; (4) extractExplicitProperties had no Expression branch
insight: A builtin MDL key and a widget's own property of the same name collide silently: the builtin always wins, and when the widget does not declare the matching system property the builtin is a no-op too. Decide the routing in the def generator, which reads the .mpk's system properties, so check and build read one answer. The cheapest probe was the reporter's table — `showEventDate:` made the CE0642 go away while `editable:` did not, which already says the explicit pass writes expressions and something else eats `editable`. Make the template write declared defaults first: that alone makes every Calendar page build, before any MDL names the property. Measured on Mendix 11.13.0 with Calendar 245304 v2.6.1: main → 2× CE0642; this branch → 0 errors with neither, both 'true' and both false/'false', and describe → exec reports Unchanged
